messages.subject: Adding lies to a barplot
parts:
I have written an age-sex profile tornado plot from scratch in R - adding a line of the standardized populations to the barplot.

This is similar to : http://www.r-bloggers.com/adding-lines-or-points-to-an-existing-barplot/

Is there any way in ggplot2 to add lines to barplots?

JNvV

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Adding lies to a barplot
parts:
In general, please provide a minimal reproducible example. That said, yes:

d <- data.frame(x=1:3,y1=4:6,y2=3:1)  # toy data set
ggplot(d,aes(x=x))+geom_bar(aes(y=y1),stat='identity')+geom_line(aes(y=y2))

Ben
